method: Read-only static audit of /home/user/SITE00; no app run, no provider/network calls, no repo writes. Production deploy determined from railway.toml (startCommand 'npm run start:api' -> tsx server/index.ts) and server/routes.ts API_ROUTES; api/*.ts files NOT listed in server/routes.ts (vision-replication.ts, hero-asset-materialize.ts, brand-creative-context.ts, dev/*) treated as not mounted in production. Searches: (1) SDK imports: grep -rln -E "from ['\"]@fal-ai/client|import\(['\"]@fal-ai/client" plus 'openai', '@anthropic-ai/', replicate/@google/genai/elevenlabs/runway/luma/stability/@ai-sdk across api server shared scripts src; (2) SDK invocations: grep -E "\bfal\.(subscribe|run|queue\.submit|queue\.result|queue\.status|stream|realtime|storage\.upload)\b" and non-prefixed queue.submit/.subscribe(; (3) provider hostnames: grep for https?://...(fal.run|fal.ai|openart|elevenlabs|kling|byteplus|seedance|runwayml|lumalabs|replicate.com|stability.ai|suno|udio|api.openai.com|api.anthropic.com|api.x.ai|generativelanguage.googleapis|aiplatform.googleapis|artlist|hedra|heygen|deepgram|assemblyai|minimax|ideogram|leonardo|bfl.ai|recraft|tripo|meshy|cartesia|playht|...); (4) Anthropic markers: grep 'ANTHROPIC_API_URL|x-api-key|anthropic-version'; (5) env var tally: grep -ohE '(process\.env|import\.meta\.env|os\.environ...)[.\[(][A-Z0-9_]+' filtered for KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|FAL|OPENAI|ANTHROPIC|XAI|GROK|..., then grep of each key name (OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, IDEOGRAM_API_KEY, PIXELCUT_API_KEY, STUDIO_WORLD_API_KEY, JURNL_ASK_PROVIDER_URL, NEWS_API_KEY); (6) every fetch(/fetchImpl(/fetchFn( call in api server shared listed per file and classified; (7) a regex import-graph tool written to the scratchpad (graph.mjs/graphlib.mjs; parses static/dynamic import specifiers, skips 'import type') used to BFS from each server/routes.ts handler, from the startup hook (shared/.../p0vr8r3/captureWorkerBoot.ts and the other server/index.ts imports) and from every scripts/ file to the set of outbound-call files (scratchpad targets.json); (8) each reachable call path then traced by hand (Read/sed/grep) from handler -> service -> call site for auth, method, spend flags, budget/quote checks, dedupe, retry and cost recording; (9) GET/poll/resume detection: awk over api/site00/projects.ts case blocks for missing 'req.method !== POST' and missing canAccessFounderProject*; grep for maybeResume*/setImmediate/enqueue*Work; review of expression-engine GET phases; grep of src/ for UI calls to dispatching GET endpoints; (10) unknown-cost handling: grep -E '(cost|credits|spend)[A-Za-z]*\s*[:=]\s*0' plus reading cost/receipt code; (11) client exposure: grep VITE_* key-like names in src/shared/api/server/scripts/vite.config.ts/.env*, provider SDK/key/hostname references in src, vite.config.ts define block, and dist/ for provider hostnames and key-shaped strings (sk-ant-, sk-proj-, xai-). (12) Compared with docs/production/provider-gateway/PROVIDER_CALL_SITE_INVENTORY.json (generatedAt 2026-10-05; 209 entries) to find gaps. Status rule used: GATED = founder/admin server-verified auth + budget/quote gate; EXPLICIT_UNBUDGETED = server-verified founder or admin-email auth on an explicit POST action, no budget/quote; CLIENT_FLAG_ONLY = no founder/admin auth, only a client-controlled spend flag (founderConfirmedSpend/explicitFounderAction/founder_initiated); UNGATED = reachable with no spend flag by an unauthenticated or any signed-in caller, OR reachable from a GET/poll/page-load/auto-resume path (even if the caller must be admin); SCRIPT_ONLY = only via scripts/; DISABLED = code present but unreachable/turned off in the deployed server; TEST_ONLY = only tests. Line numbers cite lines actually read; 'admin' = resolveAdminAuth/canAccessFounderProjectAsOwner (Supabase bearer token + email in ADMIN_EMAILS or default list api/_lib/adminAuth.ts:10-28); 'founder' = isFounderPrivilegedAccount (email === FOUNDER_PRIVILEGED_ADMIN_EMAIL, api/_lib/adminAuth.ts:8, api/_lib/site00Access/accessModel.ts:15-17).
